thread:
elena: FYI Sierra (legal/ops team) flagged an RFI + POC asks. They want: POC KPI targets, pricing for hosted vs dedicated at ~100 qps (embedding + chat), and confirmation on their standard MSS. Also asked for a capability matrix mapping encryption, VPC, HSM, audit logs across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Need to turn around by EOW.
mitesh: Thanks — can you drop the exact RFI items? I can draft the hosted/dedicated TCO quick numbers.
elena: Copied from their email: 1) latency p50/p95 SLO for chat gen and embed requests, 2) throughput and scale limits (burst to 200 qps), 3) data residency + KMS/HSM support, 4) contract term: 12 vs 36 month, liability caps, 5) audit logging retention options, 6) any SOC2/ISO certs and FedRAMP roadmap.
marco: I can own the performance/SLO bullets. For 100 qps embedding+chat we typically recommend Dedicated with 2x A100 nodes or hosted with autoscaling — sample per-token pricing below:
```
Hosted (typical): $0.0006/token gen, $0.0002/token embed (est)
Dedicated (reserved): $X/hr node -> effective $0.00035/token gen w/ utilization assumptions
```
elena: Great — can you also produce a simple capability matrix (3 columns: Hosted / Dedicated / Private) mapping KMS, HSM, VPC, audit retention, SLA, customizable kernels? Sierra wants that as an attachment in the RFI.
marco: On it. I'll reuse the internal matrix and mark caveats. quick notes: HSM via customer-managed CloudKMS integration (supported in Private + Dedicated with infra-runner), Hosted supports customer-managed KMS for keys at rest but no direct HSM attachment for now.
dawn: Legal: don't commit to their standard MSS yet. We need redlines on indemnity and liability caps. Ask for their MSS early and route to legal review. Also confirm whether they require data purge certs at POC end.
elena: Good call. I'll request their MSS and data purge requirements.
mitesh: For pricing, do we want to include a POC discount line item? Sierra expects an evaluation price (2-week POC) + optional ramp pricing.
elena: Yes — include a one-time POC credit to cover infra and support (e.g., $5k credit) and note that dedicated pricing assumes a 3-month reserve for viability.
marco: Uploading draft matrix and perf numbers here: https://redwood-internal.s3/sierral-rfi/matrix-draft.xlsx
elena: Received, thanks. Mito, Marco — can you sync for a 20m alignment at 10:30 PT? I'll invite Sierra to a brief call after we confirm numbers.
mitesh: 10:30 PT works. I'll bring a short cost calc and notes on burst autoscaling behavior.
marco: I'll bring the perf curves and test artifacts.
elena: Dawn — can you advise on any non-negotiable legal asks we should surface before the call?
dawn: Primary things: limitation of liability to a cap tied to fees, data processing addendum, breach notification timing (<=72h), and no unlimited indemnity. If they insist on MSS wholesale, we'll need to propose our standard redlines.
elena: Perfect. I'll ask Sierra to send MSS and their PII/data classification for the POC.
ops-bot: [deployment] Uploaded matrix-draft.xlsx to #sales — 1 file attached.
elena: OK I'll draft the RFI response bundle: one-pager KPI/SLOs, capability matrix, pricing sheet with POC credit, and legal checklist. Target to send by Friday COB. Anything else?
mitesh: Add a line about fallback model variants and auto-failover to lower-capacity model if latency spikes — they asked about graceful degradation.
elena: Good — adding. Thanks everyone.
marco: quick note — include a short section on observability: token-level latency breakdown, tracing hooks, and error budget alerts. That's often a differentiator.
elena: Noted. Filing action items and will share draft for review before sending.
